<a id="shape_parts"></a>
### [`shape_parts`](../../../src/fighter_shapes_8000.asm#L6) `$8000-$803F`

*data*

Fighter part graphics of M.SHAPES: part p (1-255) is the 64-byte block at shape_parts + p*64, page from $7f00, low byte from $3109. Block 0 stays unused: part number 0 means an empty part, and the shape builder never reads it. It holds 64 zero bytes.
